title: Roastday: the date on the bag

product.name: Roastday
product.one_liner: coffee subscription that ships within days of roasting, roast date printed on every bag

audience: home coffee drinkers 25-45 who buy supermarket beans and wonder why cafe coffee tastes different

hook.text: Find the date on your coffee bag.
hook.why: A visual comparison the viewer can repeat in their own kitchen tonight.

style: kitchen counter phone footage, morning light, hands only

shots.visual: Two bags side by side on the counter; a finger taps the supermarket bag's 'best before' and then the Roastday bag's 'roasted on'
shots.caption:
find the date on your coffee bag
AI-generated ad
shots.voiceover: Find the date on your coffee bag.

prompt.subject: overhead of two coffee bags on a wooden counter, a finger tapping a small printed date on each
prompt.action: the finger taps the left bag, then the right bag
prompt.negative: readable brand names, logos, text other than a date stamp

shots.visual: Supermarket bag opened, beans poured into a hand: dull, oily; a 'best before' two years out
shots.caption: best before two years out. roasted when?
shots.voiceover: A best-before date says nothing about when it was roasted.

shots.visual: Roastday bag opened; beans into the grinder; the bloom on the pour-over domes and bubbles
shots.camera: overhead, then side macro on the bloom
shots.caption: fresh beans bloom. stale ones sit flat.
shots.voiceover: Fresh beans bloom when the water hits. Stale ones sit flat. That's the whole difference.

prompt.subject: side macro of hot water poured onto fresh coffee grounds in a paper filter cone, the grounds domed and bubbling
prompt.action: water pours in a thin stream, the bed rises and bubbles, a few grounds crackle
prompt.lighting: morning window light, steam catching the light

shots.visual: The roast date stamp held to camera next to the calendar on the wall; the box's shipping label date beside it
shots.caption: roast date on the bag. ship date on the box.
shots.voiceover: Roast date on the bag, ship date on the box. Do the maths.

shots.visual: Cup lifted out of frame, bag set down with the date facing the lens
shots.caption: first bag, no subscription lock-in. link below.
shots.voiceover: First bag without a subscription lock-in. Link below.

claims.text: roast date is on the bag and the ship date is on the box
claims.evidence: shipping product and packaging; photos of a real order in the campaign folder

claims.text: first bag without a subscription lock-in
claims.evidence: checkout flow: one-off purchase option available; checked on the filming date

cta.text: First bag without a subscription lock-in. Link below.
cta.on_screen: first bag, no subscription lock-in. link below.

notes: No 'ships within 48 hours' or similar promise unless logistics confirms it in writing; the script says 'within days' only in the product one-liner, not on screen.
No taste or health claims; the bloom demo is observable, not a quality guarantee.
